legend: Every day Ruslan tried to count sheep to fall asleep, but this didn't help. Now he has found a more interesting thing to do. First, he thinks of some set of circles on a plane, and then tries to choose a beautiful set of points, such that there is at least one point from the set inside or on the border of each of the imagined circles.

Yesterday Ruslan tried to solve this problem for the case when the set of points is considered beautiful if it is given as (xt = f(t), yt = g(t)), where argument t takes all integer values from 0 to 50. Moreover, f(t) and g(t) should be correct functions.
Assume that w(t) and h(t) are some correct functions, and c is an integer ranging from 0 to 50. The function s(t) is correct if it's obtained by one of the following rules:
s(t) = abs(w(t)), where abs(x) means taking the absolute value of a number x, i.e. |x|;
s(t) = (w(t) * h(t)), where  *  means multiplication, i.e. (w(t)·h(t));
Yesterday Ruslan thought on and on, but he could not cope with the task. Now he asks you to write a program that computes the appropriate f(t) and g(t) for any set of at most 50 circles.
In each of the functions f(t) and g(t) you are allowed to use no more than 50 multiplications. The length of any function should not exceed 100·n characters. The function should not contain spaces.

Ruslan can't keep big numbers in his memory, so you should choose f(t) and g(t), such that for all integer t from 0 to 50 value of f(t) and g(t) and all the intermediate calculations won't exceed 109 by their absolute value.
input: The first line of the input contains number n (1 ≤ n ≤ 50) — the number of circles Ruslan thinks of. Next follow n lines, each of them containing three integers xi, yi and ri (0 ≤ xi, yi ≤ 50, 2 ≤ ri ≤ 50) — the coordinates of the center and the raduis of the i-th circle.
output: In the first line print a correct function f(t). In the second line print a correct function g(t). The set of the points (xt = f(t), yt = g(t)) (0 ≤ t ≤ 50) must satisfy the condition, that there is at least one point inside or on the border of each of the circles, Ruslan thinks of at the beginning.
note: 3+5+7 (not enough brackets, it should be ((3+5)+7) or (3+(5+7)))
abs(t-3) (not enough brackets, it should be abs((t-3))
1(t+5) (no arithmetic operation between 1 and the bracket)

note.ai: 1(t+5)（1 和括号之间没有算术运算符）

legend.ai: 每天 Ruslan 都试着数羊来入睡，但这并没有帮助。现在他找到了更有趣的事情来做。首先，他在平面上想象一些圆，然后尝试选择一个美丽的点集，使得对于每个想象中的圆，点集中至少有一个点位于该圆内部或边界上。
昨天，Ruslan 尝试解决这样一种情况：当点集表示为 (xₜ = f(t), yₜ = g(t)) 时，认为它是美丽的，其中自变量 t 取从 0 到 50 的所有整数值。此外，f(t) 和 g(t) 必须是正确的函数。
假设 w(t) 和 h(t) 是某些正确的函数，且 c 是一个取值范围为 0 到 50 的整数。如果 s(t) 可以通过以下规则之一得到，则称 s(t) 是正确的：
s(t) = abs(w(t))，其中 abs(x) 表示对数 x 取绝对值，即 |x|；
s(t) = (w(t) * h(t))，其中 * 表示乘法，即 (w(t)·h(t))；
昨天，Ruslan 思考了很久，但仍然无法完成这道题。现在，他请你编写一个程序，对于任意一组至多包含 50 个圆的集合，计算相应的 f(t) 和 g(t)。
在函数 f(t) 和 g(t) 中，每个函数所使用的乘法次数都不得超过 50 次。任意函数的长度不得超过 100·n 个字符。函数中不应包含空格。
Ruslan 无法在内存中保存大数，因此你应选择 f(t) 和 g(t)，使得对于从 0 到 50 的所有整数 t，f(t) 和 g(t) 的值以及所有中间计算结果的绝对值都不超过 10^9。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 50）——Ruslan 所设想的圆的数量。接下来有 n 行，每行包含三个整数 x_i、y_i 和 r_i（0 ≤ x_i,y_i ≤ 50，2 ≤ r_i ≤ 50）——第 i 个圆的圆心坐标和半径。

output.ai: 第一行输出一个正确的函数 f(t)。第二行输出一个正确的函数 g(t)。点集（x_t = f(t)，y_t = g(t)）（0 ≤ t ≤ 50）必须满足以下条件：对于 Ruslan 一开始所设想的每个圆，至少有一个点位于该圆的内部或边界上。
